title.narrative: Forum of women's NGOs of Kyrgyzstan

description.narrative: The FWNGO is uniting women's groups from rural areas to jointly resist patriarchal norms through setting and strengthening local networks of women's groups addressing local women's underrepresentation in local governance bodies. Their main mission is the consolidation and strengthening of women's NGOs in Kyrgyzstan, supporting and sustaining its women's movement building across the country, with focus on rural areas. The grant will support the following specific priorities: - Organization's administration, keeping and strengthening staff - Advocacy, movement building and capacity building activities for rural women in Kyrgyzstan. - Strengthening the organizational linkages with rural groups and strengthening solidarity and experience sharing. - Build local women's groups' capacity, helping them to integrate national and international women's rights standards into local districts development plans and budgets - Capacity development of elected women for raising and advocating for women's rights and gender equality
